question: The equipment bolt is used in which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mountaineering.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bolts are used in **sports climbing** as a backup to catch a fall.
 
• Mountaineering gear: Items such as mountaineering boots, crampons, a climbing helmet and an ice axe are standard items for almost every mountaineering climb.
 
• **Equipment:-** Helmet rubber climbing shoes climbing ropes/ high strength cord anchors harness or a set of ropes for fastening **carabineers** or hooks with safety locks belay devices rappel devices belay gloves ascenders slings nuts pitons and** ****camming devices daisy chains.**
 
• In rock climbing, an anchor can be any device or method for attaching a climber, a rope, or a load above or onto a climbing surface—typically rock, ice, steep dirt, or a building—either permanently or temporarily.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Swimmers use all kinds of **swimming pools for their pool training sessions including snorkels, **pull buoys, rubber bands, hand paddles**, kickboards** and fins. 
 
• A kickboard can be used to isolate and learn the leg movements, especially the flutter kick and the breaststroke kick.
 
• Swedish goggles, or Swedes, are among the most popular swimming goggles for competitive swimmers, and for good reason. 
 
• This sport is held on a racing bicycle or also known as a bike so the most important of all is the bicycle and the bike gears.
 
• Cycling improves strength, balance and coordination. It may also help to prevent falls and fractures.
 
• **Riding **a bike is an ideal form of exercise if you have osteoarthritis because it is a low-impact exercise that places little stress on joints.
